Literature catalog · Source build · Implementation in progress

Omics and GWAS tools across 250 papers

Nature, Nature Genetics and AJHG · October 23, 2023–October 23, 2026

Scope and required actions

250 primary-source records are catalogued. Tool extraction is registry-bounded; semantic completeness review remains open. Native overlap does not establish upstream software equivalence. Coverage badges describe tool-level integrations; read each paper-specific scope note before assuming its reported operation is supported. Missing integrations remain visible below.

If a required dependency cannot be installed, its analysis must be marked skipped, with the error, dependency and recovery steps. See the warnings and actions report.

Model and display decisions: explicitly choose force field,protonation or pH,repair/omission,water,state/alternates, Angstrom frame,temperature,grid,salt and dielectrics. Charged zero-radius atoms remain. PyMOL loads display radii; source-pqr explicitly applies supplied radii,while pymol keeps different display radii and warns. Choose excluded/accessible surface,probe radius,vertex/probe-offset sampling and a labeled three-color ramp.

DX parser / precision: original PyMOL truncates long numeric tokens and can silently lose exponents. Keep raw potential.dx and canonical short-float32 render-grid.dx. Every loaded field node must match the native float32-rounded source exactly. Keep figure.svg,the unchanged original PNG and full atom/map/ramp ledgers. Raw APBS energy is NOT solvation or binding free energy.

APBS solver: runtime, charges, grid and energy review

Development candidate apbs-workflow-candidate-3, SHA-256 starts b1c26fa4. apbs-tools runs original APBS3.5.0 LPBE/NPBE on an explicitly charged PQR model. The Windows executable is 32bit x86, tested on Windows x86_64. The canonical a104 executable is unchanged.

Required action: where permitted run python tools/literature/install_apbs.py --home NEW_PRIVATE_HOME --cache ARCHIVE_CACHE --allow-install; add --allow-download only when permitted and the pinned archive is absent. Supply the admitted --home. Analysis never installs. Missing, changed, unsupported or forbidden dependencies skip analysis with exit 3. If installation is forbidden, skip the solver analysis until an admitted runtime is supplied.

Model inputs must be explicit: charge-model provenance, Angstrom units, grid counts/lengths/center, LPBE/NPBE, boundary, dielectrics, probe radius, surface density, temperature and salt. No pH, protonation, force field, atom repair or PDB2PQR preparation is inferred. Charged zero-radius atoms are retained. The bounded profile uses mg-manual/mol/spl2; inspect original logs and grid refinement.

Successful process exit is insufficient: an all-atomic-charges-zero original calculation exits 0 but writes NaNs. Every node is audited; invalid output, input, process or timeout failures return 2 and quarantine partials. Raw total energy includes self-energy and is NOT solvation or binding free energy. Potential units are kT/e at the declared temperature; voltage conversion uses exact SI2019 k_B/e.

Native helper: electrostatic-grid needs only Java. Declare units and an outside policy; missing rows have blank values, finite zero grids remain valid, and sampling never extrapolates. Read WARNINGS.md, session.json, original logs and results.json before interpretation. Correct the named issue and rerun to a new directory. Read APBS_WORKFLOWS.md, APBS_SOURCE_REVIEW.md and apbs-adapter-validation.json. Typed preparation and map surfaces are available through pdb2pqr-tools and potential-surface;read apbs-workflow-validation.json. Historical/source-paper parameter reconstruction remain in progress.

Native molecular geometry: units and pairs require review

Available in development candidate molecular-geometry-candidate-1; its SHA-256 starts with 798d3a08. The native command needs only Java. Declare angstrom or nanometer; nanometers multiply by 10. Fits use every explicitly supplied pair and require error or allow-nonunique. No atom/sequence matching, outlier rejection, scale, reflection or periodic images are inferred. A low RMSD alone does not establish biological equivalence.

Undefined measurements fail; explicitly allowed nonunique fits warn. Read WARNINGS.md, analysis-status.json, session.yaml and fit-pairs.tsv. Errors return 2 and quarantine scientific partials. Correct the named units, IDs, pairs, geometry or limits, and rerun to a new directory. Read MOLECULAR_GEOMETRY_WORKFLOWS.md for commands and synthetic examples.

Original typed PyMOL subset is available in development candidate 09e4be51. Use pymol-tools with an admitted Linux runtime for rendering, measurements, original align/super and explicit edits. Typed APBS surface integration is available through pdb2pqr-tools,apbs-tools and potential-surface;manual interobject modelling and paper-specific reconstruction remain pending. Read PYMOL_WORKFLOWS.md. The canonical a104 executable is unchanged.
